query: 为了年度盘点，请统计：购买鞋靴超过10次的客户人数
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT o.customer_id FROM fact_order o JOIN dim_product p ON o.product_id=p.product_id WHERE p.category='鞋靴' GROUP BY o.customer_id HAVING COUNT(*)>10) t
generated_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM (
    SELECT fo.customer_id
    FROM fact_order fo
    JOIN dim_product dp ON fo.product_id = dp.product_id
    WHERE dp.category = '鞋靴'
    GROUP BY fo.customer_id
    HAVING COUNT(fo.order_id) > 10
) t
